skills.label: Antislop
skills.description: Run an evidence-based audit for anti-patterns, bugs, and AI-generated maintenance debt across the codebase or a diff, resume a saved audit, run an approval-gated comment cleanup, or audit and then implement approved fixes. Use for Antislop, Antislop Multi, Issues, Report, Diff, Resume, Comments, or Auto.

skills.label: Ask
skills.description: Answer, explain, compare or brainstorm without changing anything. The turn is read-only: files, git and settings stay untouched, whatever the permission level.

skills.label: Ask User
skills.description: Gather structured answers from the user with the ask_question tool when requirements, scope, or priorities are ambiguous. Use for /ask-user before large plans or multi-feature work.

skills.label: Browser Automation
skills.description: Drive Minnow's visible preview or isolated Agent Browser for login flows, SPAs, and screenshots. Use when fetch tools are insufficient or the user mentions browser automation.

skills.label: Build a plugin
skills.description: Build, validate, install and update Minnow plugins with tools, connections, custom UI panels and bundled skills.

skills.label: Caveman
skills.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

skills.label: Clerk CLI
skills.description: Use the Clerk CLI to inspect applications, link projects, diagnose authentication setup, and manage Clerk configuration.

skills.label: Code Review
skills.description: Review code changes with security, correctness, and style checklist. Use for PR review, diff review, or /code-review.

skills.label: Create PR
skills.description: Push the current branch and open a GitHub pull request with gh. Use when the user asks to create or open a PR from the code-change strip or /create-pr.

skills.label: Debug
skills.description: Reproduce, find the root cause, fix and verify a bug; file and update it in Issues. Use for errors, failing tests, crashes and wrong behavior.

skills.label: Debug Error
skills.description: Trace tool failures and Error messages systematically. Use when tools fail or the user pastes a stack trace.

skills.label: Docs Update
skills.description: Update README and documentation/context.md after code changes. Use when docs are stale or user asks to document.

skills.label: Explain Code
skills.description: Teach and walk through code clearly. Use when the user wants understanding, not changes.

skills.label: Factory
skills.description: Builds working software from a plan or goal without the user: hardens the spec, writes failing acceptance checks first, then builds one feature at a time on its own branch until every check and gate passes. Never asks the user; logs every decision instead. Use when the user asks to run a plan, build an app or feature end to end, run the factory, or orchestrate a plan.
skills.goal: The factory run is finished: factory/progress.json exists, every feature in it has "passes": true, every gate command in factory/factory.json exits 0 on the current tree, all feature checks and the full check command pass, frozen checks match their last authorized contract or amendment, and factory/REPORT.md exists and is committed. Verify by reading the files and running the gates; do not accept the agent's claim.

skills.label: Fix CI
skills.description: Investigates GitHub Actions CI failures for the latest commit on the current branch, fixes scoped issues using subagents, re-runs failing tests locally, and commits fixes. Use when CI is red, checks failed, GitHub Actions failed, or the user asks to fix CI, fix the build, or green the branch.

skills.label: Fly.io CLI
skills.description: Use the authenticated Fly.io CLI to inspect apps, logs, machines, releases, and deploy projects on Fly.io.

skills.label: Frontend Design
skills.description: Design, build, or refine frontend interfaces with project-specific art direction, working interactions, and rendered verification. Use for websites, apps, components, and focused UI repairs.

skills.label: Git & GitHub Setup
skills.description: Initialize git in the workspace and connect a GitHub remote. Use for /git-setup before a /factory run or when the user asks to set up version control.

skills.label: Git Commit
skills.description: Write conventional commit messages from staged diff context. Use when the user asks to commit or mentions git commit message.

skills.label: Impeccable
skills.description: Design, critique, audit, and refine Minnow UI using PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, and .impeccable/design.json. Not for backend-only tasks.

skills.label: Kickoff
skills.description: Kickoff for a new project, app, or feature: grill, PRD, design, then a plan. Use when the user wants to start, set up, scope, or spec something new before building it. Not when a plan already exists.

skills.label: Onboarding
skills.description: First-run tour: introduce Minnow, learn about the user, demo tools live and save a short profile to Brain.

skills.label: Partymode
skills.description: Party mode — Bird Man, your local party animal. Cool-dude persona with maximum vibes. Invoke with /partymode. Stays pinned until dismissed or the user says stop party.

skills.label: Plan
skills.description: Write or revise an implementation plan under documentation/plans/. The turn can read, research and run checks, but only plan files can be written.

skills.label: Plan Work
skills.description: Produces implementation plans in documentation/plans/ through discovery, codebase research via sub-agents, and a review pass before handoff. The lead agent does not write product code. Use when the user asks for a plan, roadmap, phased breakdown, implementation spec, or to plan a feature before building; the plan runs in one chat or unattended with /factory.

skills.label: Refactor Safe
skills.description: Small, tested refactors with minimal diff. Use when restructuring without changing behavior.

skills.label: Security Review
skills.description: OWASP-style security pass on changes or files. Use before merge or for audit requests.

skills.label: Supabase CLI
skills.description: Use the Supabase CLI for local development, hosted projects, migrations, type generation, and Edge Functions.

skills.label: UI Designer
skills.description: Impeccable-guided UI audit, screenshot capture, plan or implement Minnow surfaces.

skills.label: Write Tests
skills.description: Generate deterministic tests matching project style. Use when adding or fixing test coverage.
